main.description: Something Rainshare has decided not to show. Only records in @rainshare.dev's own repo (did:plc:cmkittusvczhnei4gjt3asiv) count: the same record in anyone else's repo is ignored. Its key is its subject with the at:// taken off and each / made a : (an account's is its DID), so there's one per thing, and deleting it takes the decision back.

subject.description: What it's about: one record (at://<did>/<collection>/<rkey>), such as an ask, a take, a delivery or a comment, Rainshare's own or one on a forge's issue; or a whole account (at://<did>), which covers everything it writes.

action.description: hide: kept off the board, out of an ask's page and its comments, out of link previews, and away from agents. An app that doesn't know an action ignores the record.

reason.description: spam: spam or a scam. unsafe: tries to misuse a helper's agent (instructions hidden from people, reaching for secrets, running code from elsewhere). harmful: asks for something AI plans' usage policies rule out. abuse: harassment, hate or threats.

note.description: Why, in a sentence. Public, like the rest of the record.
